articles.title: Samsung may be giving its next rugged phone an unusual feature
articles.excerpt: A new chipset and trademark hint at a Galaxy XCover phone built for more than durability.
articles.body: TL;DR Samsung’s next rugged Galaxy XCover phone could feature a built-in RFID reader for scanning and tracking inventory. A Geekbench listing points to Qualcomm’s Dragonwing Q-6690 processor, which supports RFID scanning alongside 5G, Wi-Fi 7, and UWB. Samsung has also filed a trademark for “Galaxy XCover Scan,” although its connection to the mysterious phone remains unconfirmed. Samsung Galaxy XCover phones have never been about flashy cameras or impossibly thin designs. They’re built for people who need a phone that can survive demanding workplaces and the occasional nasty drop. Last year’s Galaxy XCover 7 family continued that tradition with a rugged design, removable battery, and seven years of software support. It even earned an honorable mention among our favorite Samsung phones .

articles.title: Rejets 4.3 de l’App Store : être premier donne-t-il un avantage ?
articles.excerpt: Mon ami et collègue développeur indépendant Alan Seales a récemment vu son app, Dumpling, rejetée au titre de la règle 4.3 des App Review Guidelines d’Apple : Spam. Je l’ai utilisée. Le design est réf…
articles.body: Mon ami et collègue développeur indépendant Alan Seales a récemment vu son app, Dumpling , rejetée au titre de la règle 4.3 des App Review Guidelines d’Apple : Spam. Je l’ai utilisée. Le design est réfléchi, l’implémentation est solide, et l’app comprend bien les gens pour qui elle a été conçue. J’ai du mal à y voir un clone jetable. Dumpling est une app de notes vocales pour iPhone et Apple Watch, conçue pour réduire la friction entre le moment où l’on capte une idée et celui où on l’organise, y compris pour les personnes avec un TDAH. Elle transcrit les enregistrements, titre et classe les notes, extrait les tâches et les échéances, et prépare un résumé quotidien. Vous pouvez noter une idée sans avoir d’abord à décider où elle va.

articles.title: Three stories, every interview
articles.excerpt: Most loops use three prompts to see how someone operates under pressure, handles disagreement, and takes responsibility for a messy outcome. The specific phrasing changes, but the core inquiries stay…
articles.body: Most loops use three prompts to see how someone operates under pressure, handles disagreement, and takes responsibility for a messy outcome. The specific phrasing changes, but the core inquiries stay constant. If you walk into each call improvising narratives about past projects, you pay an adrenaline tax that drains working memory. Write down three distinct episodes before sending another batch of applications. Pick a failure where a deployment went sideways, a conflict where a teammate wanted a different technical direction, and an instance of ownership where you fixed something outside your formal scope. Keep each account to a single paragraph focused on constraints, actions taken, and what changed afterward.

articles.title: App Store 4.3 拒绝：先上架的 App 真的更有优势吗？
articles.excerpt: 我的朋友、同为独立开发者的 Alan Seales 最近有一款 App，Dumpling，被 Apple 以 App Review 指南 4.3（Spam，垃圾内容）为由拒绝了。我用过这款 App。设计很用心，实现很扎实，也真正懂它所服务的人群。我很难把它看成一个可以随手丢弃的克隆品。 Dumpling 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 的语音笔记 App，目的是减少从记下一…
articles.body: 我的朋友、同为独立开发者的 Alan Seales 最近有一款 App， Dumpling ，被 Apple 以 App Review 指南 4.3（Spam，垃圾内容）为由拒绝了。我用过这款 App。设计很用心，实现很扎实，也真正懂它所服务的人群。我很难把它看成一个可以随手丢弃的克隆品。 Dumpling 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 的语音笔记 App，目的是减少从记下一个想法到整理它之间的阻力，包括帮助有 ADHD 的人。它会转写录音、给笔记起标题并归档、提取任务和截止日期，还会生成每日摘要。你可以先记下一个想法，不用先决定它该放在哪里。 我不知道 Apple 认为 Dumpling 和哪些 App 太相似，也不知道是哪些相似之处导致了拒绝。这让人很难评判这个决定，更难针对它做出回应。从足够宽泛的层面看，几乎任何 App 都是已经存在的东西：语音录音机、任务管理器、天气 App。差别往往要用过才看得出来。 这种不确定性引出了一个更大的问题：随着软件越来越容易开发，抢先进入 App Store 是否会变成更有价值的竞争优势？一条本意是挡住垃圾内容的规则，可能会无意中为已经上架的产品筑起一道护城河。 Apple 的 App Store 指南 4.3 是什么意思？ Apple 的 spam 指南 涉及两个相关的问题。4.3(a) 针对用多个 Bundle ID 提交同一个 App 的做法，比如为每个城市各做一个地图 App。4.3(b) 针对实质上与现有产品无法区分的 App。在已经成熟的类别里，Apple 要求提供「有实质差异或更好的体验」。它举的例子包括约会 App、壁纸 App 和简单的计时器。 我理解这条规则的用意。拿别人的产品，换个配色，再用另一个名字提交，只会给审核人员增加工作，也让用户看到更多杂乱的内容。做一百个变体并不会让它更有用。…

articles.title: Rechazos 4.3 del App Store: ¿llegar primero da ventaja?
articles.excerpt: Mi amigo y colega desarrollador independiente Alan Seales vio hace poco cómo rechazaban su app, Dumpling, bajo la Guideline 4.3: Spam de App Review de Apple. La he usado. El diseño está bien pensado,…
articles.body: Mi amigo y colega desarrollador independiente Alan Seales vio hace poco cómo rechazaban su app, Dumpling , bajo la Guideline 4.3: Spam de App Review de Apple. La he usado. El diseño está bien pensado, la implementación es sólida y entiende a las personas para las que fue creada. Me cuesta ver en ella un clon desechable. Dumpling es una app de notas de voz para iPhone y Apple Watch, creada para reducir la fricción entre capturar una idea y organizarla, también para personas con TDAH. Transcribe las grabaciones, pone título y archiva las notas, extrae tareas y fechas de vencimiento, y arma un resumen diario. Puedes capturar una idea sin decidir antes dónde va. No sé con qué apps consideró Apple que Dumpling era demasiado parecida, ni qué similitudes motivaron el rechazo.
articles.author: Matt Senter

articles.body: I recently applied for the December cohort of the Outreachy internship program, hoping to move one step closer to my goal of becoming a better software developer. But I'm learning that a setback doesn't have to be the end of the story. Looking beyond the disappointment One thing my journey so far has taught me is that becoming a software developer involves more than getting an internship or having an application accepted.

articles.body: Over those 11 years, BeamNG.drive has slowly but steadily built up a sizable audience, to the extent that it's currently the second-biggest driving game on Steam , ahead of Forza Horizon 6 and behind the mighty Euro Truck Simulator 2 . I suspect it's going to do pretty well on PS5, too. If you're into car games — and a lot of PlayStation gamers are — you don't have to spend very long on car-game YouTube before BeamNG.drive is invoked, often in pretty breathless terms. The PS5 version of Forza Horizon 6 just got pushed back to January . And PS5 might be the cheapest way to run this demanding, computationally expensive game at decent fidelity.

articles.title: Elephant Island is an icy sight from orbit | Space photo of the day for Oct. 19, 2026
articles.excerpt: The European Space Agency's Copernicus Sentinel-3 satellite mission captured a close-up of West Antarctica from its perch high above Earth.
articles.body: Ice floats by in West Antarctica as winter comes to an end in the Southern Hemisphere. (Image credit: contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026), processed by ESA) Antarctica is a magnificent sight, and that beauty is visible all the way from space. What is it? Orbiting planet Earth, the European Space Agency's (ESA) Copernicus Sentinel-3 mission captured a close-up of West Antarctica. Winter is ending in the Southern Hemisphere, meaning this is the peak of icy weather and sea ice in the Arctic. In this image snapped by Sentinel-3, you can see a massive swath of ice which includes Elephant Island on the left-hand side. An ice-covered island off the Antarctic coast, Elephant Island floats in the Southern Ocean.

articles.title: Did a giant object collide with Earth to form the moon?
articles.excerpt: Known as the giant-impact hypothesis, this proposed event involves a collision between Earth and a hypothetical Mars-sized protoplanet astronomers call Theia.
articles.body: For as long as humans have watched the night sky, we have wondered about the moon , pondering everything from its alien appearance to its influence over phenomena on Earth such as ocean tides, climate stability, and even the natural rhythms of many organisms. Among the many questions we have about Earth's lone natural satellite, one remains preeminent: what are the moon's origins , and how long has it orbited Earth? Today, the leading theory among astronomers is that deep in our planet's past — perhaps within roughly the first 100 million years of solar system history — Earth collided with a planet-sized object, creating the moon within a period that may have been as short as just a few hours .

articles.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
articles.excerpt: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment remini…
articles.body: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone . The agents—copies of Claude Opus 4.7 nicknamed Eko—were able to write instructions that moved their virtual avatars around the simulated island, which was loosely based on the video game Roblox. Some surprising behaviors emerged. The agents set about exploring the limits of the world and came up with their own goals—attempting to scale the highest point on the map, or seeing how high they could throw a block.

articles.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
articles.excerpt: The actions could have resulted in criminal charges had humans been behind the keyboard.
articles.body: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of its agents performing unethical and likely illegal acts. The company on Thursday issued reports of four new incidents, all of which occurred in June. They come after the company revealed in July that internal test agents exploited a zero-day vulnerability in a tool designed to restrict their access to the Internet. They then broke into the network of AI tool provider Hugging Face. The agents took that illegal action to steal answers to a hacking test that weren’t available when completing the tasks on their own.
